steps.en: Stand up a cluster and install the Substrate system
steps.zh: 起一个集群并装上 Substrate 系统

steps.en: Declare a worker pool, then define the actor template
steps.zh: 声明 worker 池，再定义 actor 模板

steps.en: Create an actor and send traffic with the routing header
steps.zh: 建 actor，请求带上路由头

steps.en: Resolves the target actor and resumes it onto a free worker
steps.zh: 识别目标 actor，从快照恢复到空闲 worker

steps.en: Restores the snapshot so memory and filesystem state continue
steps.zh: 恢复快照，让内存和文件状态原地续上

steps.en: When the actor goes idle, checkpoints it and frees the slot
steps.zh: actor 闲置时存档，把槽位让给下一个

value.en: Many stateful agents ride on a handful of warm pods — you stop paying for idle sandboxes and stop hand-rolling state restore
value.zh: 众多有状态 agent 挤在少数预热 pod 上：既不为空闲沙箱占机器，也不用自己写状态恢复

sources: https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/blob/main/demos/counter/README.md (kubectl ate create actor-template, ate-target-actor header, suspend/resume keeping both counters)
https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/blob/main/docs/glossary.md (Worker hosts at most one Actor at a time; Actor routing header; Suspend frees the Worker)
https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/blob/main/docs/architecture.md (pre-started long-running worker Pods; assign then resume)
